— 01   Mission

We Look
Out for
Each Other.

Construction workers face the second-highest suicide rate of any industry. One thousand die from workplace accidents each year — five thousand die by suicide. You are sixteen times more likely to die by suicide or overdose than from a fall, an electrocution, or any jobsite hazard.

The NM Building Trades Wellness Coalition was built to change that. We are the third coalition of our kind in the nation — bringing every trade together around mental health, peer support, and recovery. No silos. No stigma. Just workers looking out for each other.

Peer Support
Trained peer specialists embedded in your local — tradespeople who have been through it and know how to help.
Vital Cog Training
Two-hour suicide prevention training delivered at union halls, contractor meetings, and job sites across the state.
Mental Health Resources
Naloxone within three minutes of every worker on every job site. EAP access. AA/NA. Recovery centers. All in one place.
Statewide Coverage
From Albuquerque to the patch — every worker in New Mexico has access to the coalition's support network.

If You're
Struggling
Right Now.

You don't have to have it figured out. You don't have to know what to say. Just call or text. The Suicide & Crisis Lifeline is free, confidential, and available around the clock.

— 02   Resources

Tools for
the Trade.

— R.01
Your Union EAP
Every building trades local has an Employee Assistance Program. Free counseling, referrals, and support — paid for by your union benefits.
Find your EAP →
— R.02
AA & NA Meetings
Alcoholics Anonymous and Narcotics Anonymous meetings available across New Mexico — in person and online, every day of the week.
Find a meeting →
— R.03
Recovery Centers
Treatment facilities, detox programs, and long-term recovery support across New Mexico. We can help you find the right fit.
Get connected →
— R.04
Peer Specialists
Talk to someone who's been there. Certified peer support specialists who are tradespeople in recovery.
Find a peer →
— R.05
Narcan / Naloxone
Free naloxone kits for job sites across New Mexico. Reverse an opioid overdose on site. We provide kits and train your crew.
Request training →
— R.06
Vital Cog Training
Two-hour suicide prevention class — at your hall, your site, your schedule. Available to all NM building trades locals and contractors.
Schedule training →

Who Do
